text:
alex: Heads-up: a support report suggests our console saved view default surprised a customer with higher cost. Quick callout: should the per-route default view be 'latency-optimized' or 'cost-optimized' when a model is pinned?

mira: My take: split by workload. Interactive/API routes default to latency, batch/embeddings default to cost. But the console should surface the cost delta up front.

jason: Implementation note: current response for /api/routes/:id/view returns preset as a string and clients cache it. Changing server default will break cached assumptions. We can add opt-in `ui_preset=auto` and return `preset_source` so clients can show provenance. Example: `GET /api/routes/42/view?ui_preset=auto`.

kevin: Telemetry required. We must tag route-view events with `route_view_preset` and `preset_source` and include `model_variant` so we can correlate cost spikes. Our sampling currently omits preset name.

sara: FYI Acme filed the ticket. They saved a view, later rotated model and saw cost jump. They expect the console to warn about estimated token-cost differences.

mira: UX proposal: presets dropdown with micro-badges showing delta: `Latency (est +5ms, +$0.08/10k)`; hover shows calculation and assumptions. Also an inline banner when a saved view's estimated cost delta >10%.

alex: Rollout idea: canary defaults by route tag. e.g., 10% of routes get cost-first for two weeks and we compare unit-cost. If cost rises >15% for canary we roll back.

jason: Plan: add `preset_policy` in route config (values: fixed|auto|policy). Add a routing policy service that resolves the computed preset based on route metadata and client hint. Keep server default unchanged unless route config present. Response shape: "preset":"latency", "preset_source":"server-default|route-config|user" so clients can display where it came from.

kevin: Monitoring: add histogram `token_cost_per_request` with labels `route_view_preset` and `model_variant`. Create a dashboard comparing median cost pre/post and an alert when pct change >15%.

mira: Actions: 1) Figma mock for badge + banner (design). 2) API spec PR adding `ui_preset=auto` and `preset_policy` (jason). 3) Telemetry update + dashboard (kevin). 4) 2-week canary config and rollback alert.

jason: I'll open the PR today and include migration notes and an example snippet for JS SDK: `const view = await client.getRouteView(123, { ui_preset: 'auto' })` and show how to read `preset_source`.

deploy-bot: Deploy to staging scheduled 2024-07-12T02:00:00Z  includes telemetry events for `route_view_preset`.

alex: Thanks. Mira please file the policy doc and tag eng/ops. Kevin, make sure the dashboard has comparison by model variant and route tag. If anyone objects speak up now. :thumbsup:

mira: Will do. Filing doc and adding a short checklist for customer communications (how to explain default behavior and how to pin a preset).

sara: Also add a short in-console CTA for customers who save a view to preview cost impact before saving. That should cut down surprises.

alex: Agreed. We'll iterate on wording. Closing unless new concerns.
